title: VTC Elections — Cancel — payload
description: An administrator cancels an election before voting closes: the community stops issuing its tickets and has the ballot box cancel it. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

reason.description: Why the election is cancelled, for the community's audit trail and its members. Required: a cancellation discards every ballot cast, and the members who cast them are owed a reason.

Response.title: VTC Elections — Cancel — response payload
Response.description: Success response to vtc/elections/cancel/0.1: the election's state once cancelled.
